_README: Optional captions for gallery photos. You can delete this _README key.
Key = the exact filename you placed in assets/images/gallery/originals/
alt     = description for screen readers and search engines. Write a real one.
caption = text shown under the photo. Omit for none.
group   = section heading it appears under.
order   = lower numbers appear first. Default 9999.
Groups render in this order: Our shop, Workshop & repairs, Spare parts & stock,
Printers we supply, Our team, Photos. Any other name works and is appended.
